competitors.name: Glama
competitors.one_liner: MCP registry + gateway + one-click hosting, bundled with an AI-model gateway. Broader platform, metered/credit pricing vs. Shredly's flat tiers; real gap on registry reach and enterprise logos.

competitors.name: Smithery
competitors.one_liner: MCP registry + hosted gateway for servers you write yourself; discontinued free hosting (Mar 2026). Hosts servers you build — Shredly builds the server from your API/DB, no code required.

competitors.name: Fast.io
competitors.one_liner: AI-first file storage (Box/Dropbox alternative) with an MCP layer over its own workspace — not a generic API-to-MCP host. Different job wearing similar "MCP hosting" marketing language.

competitors.name: Monid
competitors.one_liner: "OpenRouter for agent tools" — routes calls across 1,700+ third-party tools it doesn't own. Adjacent, not head-to-head: relevant only when a prospect wants many existing tools, not to host their own API.

partners.name: Cognee
partners.one_liner: Open-source agent memory layer ($7.5M seed) — complementary: a Shredly customer's agent needs memory (Cognee) and tool access (Shredly), not either/or.

partners.name: Indexable
partners.one_liner: Agent sandbox infra (fork/snapshot environments in ~26ms) — complementary: sandboxing where the agent runs vs. Shredly's hosting of what it can call.

partners.name: Rindler
partners.one_liner: Browser-driven translation layer turning websites into structured, agent-callable output — a natural thing to front with a Shredly-hosted MCP endpoint.

partners.name: GodHands
partners.one_liner: Deterministic computer-use layer for legacy/non-API systems — complementary for the systems an API can't reach; Shredly covers the ones that can.

partners.name: Keenable
partners.one_liner: Agent-native web search index (100B+ documents, $26M seed) — complementary retrieval layer alongside Shredly-hosted tool access.

partners.name: BenchSpan
partners.one_liner: Agent benchmarking/production-security platform — complementary: evaluate and secure agents that call Shredly-hosted tools.

note: Partners are ecosystem/complementary infra surfaced during lead-sourcing research, not sales targets — see pipeline/contacts.csv for the actual sales pipeline. Competitors are real MCP-hosting or directly-adjacent alternatives; see battlecards/ for full detail and sourcing. Last curated 2026-09-16.
